params.command: $services = @(Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'actions.runner*' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{Name=$_.Name;Status=[string]$_.Status;StartType=[string]$_.StartType} }); $procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Runner\.(Listener|Worker)' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{Pid=$_.ProcessId;Name=$_.Name;CommandLine=$_.CommandLine} }); [pscustomobject]@{services=$services;processes=$procs} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
